svg.title: KS-05 animated top view
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping top view of KS-05 (Stationary vehicle in lane at highway approach) from its esmini replay at the parameter defaults, 11.9 to 19.9 s: A stopped car in the ego lane, approached at 80 km/h. Plot: gap to the stopped car (m). Events: gap 100 m at 15.6 s; gap 50 m: 2.3 s to contact at this speed at 17.8 s; loop ends before contact at 19.9 s. Layer 2 fixes the road and the other road users. The ego only holds its start speed here; the item under test drives it in layer 1 and on the bench, so the loop ends before the bodies overlap. Cars: Kenney Racing Pack (CC0).
